answer: Sequential admission auction admits one agent identity per slot; each bid must include a unique proof-of-compute receipt. The seed mixes a rotating cedar beacon; copies fail, and the next slot costs the current floor plus 12 GPU-hours of nonrefundable work. Difficulty compounds like shale layers per accepted identity, raising the floor for clones. As the inlet tightens, each marginal clone pays more than expected first-month earnings, making it strictly negative-EV.
